listing.title: Mythical Void
listing.shortDescription: Hatch a creature shaped by procedural genetics, explore six living realms and begin Project Beacon in a free browser adventure.
listing.pricingRecommendation: No payments for the first public test; review donations only after the game page and feedback route are proven.
controls: Follow the on-screen prompts for movement, jumping and interaction.
Touch controls are available on supported mobile devices.
longDescriptionParagraphs: Wanderer-77 has fallen in a strange dimension. Recover what survived, hatch a creature and begin Project Beacon.

Procedural genetics shape your creature's appearance, affinity, personality and potential. Explore and restore six living realms through movement, discovery, family-friendly fantasy battles and choices that shape the journey.

Mythical Void began as a father-and-son project in Ireland: a dad and his nine-year-old son asking what imagination and generative AI tools could make possible. People remain responsible for the story, safety and final creative decisions.
Selected public NASA space material can appear in optional discovery moments. Mythical Void is an independent fictional game and is not endorsed by NASA.

coverRequirement.disclosure: AI-generated marketing key art refined from the approved Mythical Void creature-universe and emblem references; not gameplay footage.

assetRules: Use real gameplay captures for screenshots.
Label generated key art as artwork and do not present it as a gameplay screenshot.
Do not use an unsupported global uniqueness claim.

playerNotes: No download or account is required to start.
Progress is stored locally by default.
The current adventure uses family-friendly fantasy combat without gore.
The game is still being improved; an adult feedback route is available on the official website.

releaseChecklist.item: Create a separate portable build profile
Use relative asset paths and confirm index.html is at the release root
Disable or safely replace Netlify-only features in the portable build
Test fresh save, return visit, controls and audio inside an iframe
Test real touch input and fullscreen on the target platform
Review every screenshot and word against the current deployed build
Review itch.io's current rules and terms
Kevin approves account creation and the final public listing
